name: did-atp-proof
description: Runnable reference proof of concept for the did:atp DID method (hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65).
comment: Run from the repository root with `npx tsx proof/index.ts`. Dependencies (@noble/ed25519, @noble/post-quantum, @noble/hashes, @scure/base) are provided by the repository's root node_modules; this proof reuses the production SDK in ../packages/sdk.
